label: sound
instruction_covers: node_info dicts expose node_checksum: the source checksum string when the node has one, and None when checksum is missing or None, with the key still present
The protobuf NodeInfo message exposes the same field as node_checksum, which the existing LogStartLine dict-to-proto path already maps field-for-field
Existing node_info fields such as meta stay intact
notes: FileHash.checksum is the source checksum written to the manifest; the functional test compares against manifest nodes[id].checksum.checksum. SeedNode with a FileHash and SourceDefinition/ModelNode without a checksum are the stated available vs unavailable cases, not extra APIs. test_command.sh runs base and new; the patched test_meta still checks existing meta payloads, now keyed by unique_id which node_info already has. The engineer must update the generated pb2 as well as the proto, because events are built from the generated descriptor; that is the stated protobuf contract, not a hidden behavior.
